terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

terms.name: Organizational dependency
terms.definition: Material reliance by an organization on an AI-enabled capability to conduct operations, make decisions, or sustain service. Consequences depend on alternatives, retained expertise, and capacity to continue or recover without the capability.
